contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver-plated contemporary copy of a Denarius of Septimius Severus. AD196-210 (Reece period 10). Reverse legend reads [...]OR TR [...]. Reverse shows Fortuna standing left, holding cornucopiae and resting on column. Copying a coin minted in Rome. This coin appears to have been deliberately cut. Obverse shows Laureate bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is…
